Sodium 5-ox- opyrrolidine-2-carboxylate. Натрий Пидолат C5H7NNaO3 = 152.1. CAS — 28874-51-3 (DL-sodium pidolate); 54571-67-4 (L- sodium pidolate). Profile Sodium pidolate is used as a humectant. It is applied topically as a cream or lotion, often in multi-ingredient preparations, in the treatment of dry skin disorders. Copper and zinc pidolate are used similarly; they have also been used as nutritional supplements.
